disposition_reason: Tables 2-5 print mean cadmium, nickel, lead, cobalt and chromium (fresh weight) for 82 fruit and vegetable entries bought at the Sao Paulo wholesale center.

study.design: market survey of the most commonly traded fruits and vegetables (223 samples of 83 plant species), with daily intake and hazard quotients
study.origin: Brazilian states of origin per row (SP, BA, MG, SC, PR, ES, PE, GO, SE, RS) as printed
study.market: Sao Paulo General Warehousing and Centers Company (CEAGESP) wholesale, Sao Paulo, Brazil
study.method: washed, edible parts air-dried 65 °C, HNO3/HClO4 (3:1) block digestion, AAS (Varian SpectrAA 140); triplicate analysis
lod: in digest solution: Cd < 0.01 mg/L, Ni < 0.09 mg/L, Pb < 0.09 mg/L, Cr < 0.06 mg/L (table footnotes)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1515 Apple Leaves recoveries: Cd 123%, Co 81% (noncertified), Cr 75% (noncertified), Ni 80%, Pb 78% (Table 1)
